nodes.description: Constant storage slot (keccak256("PROXIABLE")) holding the address of the implementation/logic contract used by the proxy.
Public constructor that validates contractLogic is non-zero and stores it in the PROXIABLE slot via inline assembly.
Payable fallback that forwards all calldata to the stored logic address using delegatecall, propagating return data or reverting.
Constructor parameter holding the implementation contract address that will be written into the PROXIABLE mem slot.
External caller; any account can invoke the payable fallback and thereby drive the delegatecall with arbitrary calldata.
Raw inline-assembly sstore writing the implementation address directly into a fixed storage slot, bypassing Solidity storage layout checks.
Raw delegatecall to the implementation address loaded from storage, executing arbitrary external code with the proxy's storage, balance and address.
Unbounded copying of the caller-supplied calldata into memory and its length passed straight into delegatecall, giving the callee full control over executed bytecode.
Local assembly value produced by sload(PROXIABLE_MEM_SLOT); it becomes the delegatecall target and is not validated at call time.
Local assembly flag returned by delegatecall that selects between revert and return of the returndata.

edges.reason: The constructor body executes the inline-assembly sstore that persists the implementation address.
The contractLogic parameter value is written verbatim into the fixed PROXIABLE storage slot.
contractLogic is the constructor argument consumed by the constructor's zero-address require check.
The PROXIABLE_MEM_SLOT constant is used as the storage key of the assembly sstore.
The fallback body unconditionally reaches the delegatecall instruction with the caller-supplied calldata.
sload(PROXIABLE_MEM_SLOT) reads the slot constant to produce the logicAddr local.
The delegatecall target comes straight from storage and receives execution rights over the proxy without any per-call authorisation check.
Arbitrary caller calldata copied at unsafe_operation 7 is forwarded as the calldata of the delegatecall.
Any external account (msg.sender) can trigger the payable fallback, so access to the delegatecall path is unrestricted.
The delegatecalled implementation runs in the proxy's context and can re-enter the proxy fallback (directly or via callbacks) while the original call is still executing.

normalization_plan.reason: The contractLogic parameter has no independent semantic role; it flows directly into the assembly sstore that writes the PROXIABLE slot, so it should be folded into that unsafe_operation.
The sload result local is only used as the target of the delegatecall and carries no separate meaning, so it should be merged into the delegatecall unsafe_operation.
The success flag exists solely to branch on the delegatecall result and should be absorbed into the delegatecall unsafe_operation.
